basic_info.description: Elegant Edwardian condominium in Pacific Heights with private backyard! This lovely two-bedroom residence boasts wonderful period details throughout including wainscoting, moldings, and hardwood flooring. The striking formal living room features a gas fireplace with marble surround, built-ins, and French doors out to a fantastic patio and garden. The eat-in kitchen has been updated with quartz countertops and includes Tuscan-style terracotta tile flooring and a spacious breakfast area. The primary bedroom is filled with light from a west-facing bay window and offers a large walk-in closet, and the 2nd bedroom, which could be used as a formal dining room, has a built-in custom closet. The attractive bath is well-appointed with a double vanity and a shower over Jacuzzi tub, with an adjacent walk-in storage closet off the hallway. The exclusive backyard is beautifully landscaped with mature plants, with a paved area for seating and a standalone, finished studio, great as an office, gym, or storage. The unit includes 1-car independent garage parking, shared laundry, and storage. This 6-unit building is fabulously located just 1.5 blocks from Alta Plaza Park, and a few blocks from the Divisadero corridor, Fillmore St, Mollie Stone's grocery, transportation, and the Presidio.
